subject: Can't extract FIT statistics CFA mirt?

messages.author: 08146071976f553f
messages.subject: Can't extract FIT statistics CFA mirt?
parts:
Hello,

I've succesfully preformed CFA's with mirt. However I am not able to get general fit statistics with the extract.mirt function. How can I obtain these?

> extract.mirt(fit_CFA_1_original,'RMSEA')
[1] 0
> extract.mirt(fit_CFA_1_original,'TLI')
[1] NaN
> extract.mirt(fit_CFA_1_original,'RMSEA')
[1] 0

Strangely it does return BIC but not the others mentioned above.
> extract.mirt(fit_CFA_1_original,'BIC')
[1] 114598.1

Cheers, Guido

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can't extract FIT statistics CFA mirt?
parts:
You generally don't want the default fit statistics provided by the model (other than information indices) as they are quite unstable and not theoretically optimal. Try using the M2() function to obtain better goodness-of-fit statistics based on collapsing the complete tables of frequency counts to only first/second order information. HTH.

Phil
